# CDL Marketing

> CDL Marketing is a flooring marketing agency, part of CDL Management in Kirksville, Missouri. We own and run flooring showrooms ourselves, and we do marketing for flooring stores and flooring companies across the United States: flooring SEO, local SEO and Google Business Profiles, flooring website design, Google and Facebook ads, and AI search visibility (GEO). Marketing is month-to-month: if we don't do what we say, clients can let us go.

Contact: (217) 217-1705, caleb@cdl1.net. Founder: Caleb Foglesong.

## Services
- [Marketing for Flooring Stores | Flooring Marketing Agency | CDL](https://cdlmanagement.com/): Marketing for flooring stores from a team that runs flooring showrooms: websites, local SEO, Google and Facebook ads and AI search. Month to month.
- [Flooring Website Design for Flooring Stores | CDL Marketing](https://cdlmanagement.com/services/websites/): Flooring showroom website design with clear product pages, installation information and inquiry paths. Review the proposed build, monthly care and pricing.
- [Flooring Store SEO | Local SEO for Flooring Stores | CDL](https://cdlmanagement.com/services/local-seo/): Flooring store SEO for independent showrooms: Google Business Profile, product and town pages, reviews and listings, reviewed against calls and sold jobs.
- [Google Ads for Flooring Stores & Facebook Ads | CDL](https://cdlmanagement.com/services/paid-ads/): Google Ads for flooring stores, plus Facebook and Instagram, with matching landing pages and tracked calls. Management fee quoted, ad budget paid direct.
- [AI Search & GEO for Flooring Stores: ChatGPT, Google AI | CDL](https://cdlmanagement.com/services/ai-search/): Practical SEO, AEO and GEO work for flooring showrooms: accurate store facts, useful answers and documented AI-search observations. See the process and scope.
- [Flooring Marketing Services | CDL Marketing](https://cdlmanagement.com/services/): Websites, local SEO, Google and Meta ads, and AI search visibility for independent flooring showrooms. Agree on the work your store needs.
- [Flooring Website & Marketing Pricing | CDL Marketing](https://cdlmanagement.com/pricing/): Proposed website-only plan: $500/month + $1,500 one-time setup. Marketing services and media are separate. Review scope, care and terms before committing.

## Guides and research
- [Flooring Store Marketing: A Practical Guide for Showrooms](https://cdlmanagement.com/blog/marketing-for-flooring-stores/): Flooring store marketing in the order that works: Google Business Profile, a fast site, local SEO, reviews, ads and tracking sold jobs. From showroom operators.
- [We tested 831 flooring store websites on a phone](https://cdlmanagement.com/blog/flooring-store-website-speed-study/): We ran Google's phone speed test on 831 independent flooring store websites in 49 states. One in ten scored in the good range. The data and what to fix first.
- [Broadlume Alternatives for Independent Flooring Stores](https://cdlmanagement.com/blog/broadlume-alternatives/): Looking at Broadlume alternatives? The real options for an independent flooring store, how each provider describes itself, and what to check before you switch.
- [How a flooring store should track phone calls: the setup we use](https://cdlmanagement.com/blog/flooring-store-call-tracking/): How to track phone calls at a flooring store: one number per channel, every call logged and graded, each lead tied to a sold job. From our own showrooms.
- [How flooring stores can show up in ChatGPT and AI search](https://cdlmanagement.com/blog/flooring-store-chatgpt-ai-search/): A suggested AI-search observation method for flooring stores, useful website and listing checks, and the limits of visibility measurement.
- [What a flooring store website should have: the checklist we use](https://cdlmanagement.com/blog/flooring-store-website-checklist/): What a flooring store website should have: a site you control, real photos, plain pricing, guide pages, store data and tracked calls. From showroom operators.
- [Google Ads for flooring stores: what we check in our own accounts](https://cdlmanagement.com/blog/google-ads-for-flooring-stores/): How to run Google Ads for a flooring store: count real leads, block searches that never buy, send clicks to the right page and judge by sold jobs.
- [Google Business Profile for flooring stores: a practical checklist](https://cdlmanagement.com/blog/google-business-profile-for-flooring-stores/): A practical Business Profile checklist for flooring stores: accurate categories, services, hours, contact paths and measurement with clear limits.
- [Local SEO for flooring stores: a showroom operator checklist](https://cdlmanagement.com/blog/local-seo-for-flooring-stores/): Practical local SEO guidance for flooring stores: accurate profiles, useful showroom pages, website access, customer questions and measurement limits.
- [Flooring Marketing Insights | CDL Marketing](https://cdlmanagement.com/blog/): Practical guides to flooring store marketing, local SEO, Google Business Profile and AI search from a team that operates showrooms.
- [CDL Marketing vs Broadlume | Flooring Agency Comparison](https://cdlmanagement.com/compare/broadlume/): Compare CDL Marketing with Broadlume and Cyncly: services, published evidence, scope and questions to ask before choosing a flooring marketing provider.
- [How to Choose a Flooring Marketing Agency | CDL Marketing](https://cdlmanagement.com/guides/choosing-a-flooring-marketing-agency/): A practical checklist for flooring showroom owners comparing marketing agencies: scope, pricing, websites, data, proof and questions to ask.
- [Flooring Website Switch Checklist | CDL Marketing](https://cdlmanagement.com/guides/switching-flooring-website-providers/): Check contract dates, account control, content rights, analytics and inquiry routes before planning a flooring website move, cutover or rollback.
- [Flooring Marketing Checklist | CDL Marketing](https://cdlmanagement.com/guides/flooring-marketing-checklist/): Check your flooring website, local information and advertising. Organize observations for a useful first review, with no score or contact details required.
- [Your First Flooring Marketing Review | CDL Marketing](https://cdlmanagement.com/guides/your-first-marketing-review/): Prepare for a flooring marketing review: what to bring, how to assess your current website, and how SEO, advertising and a careful transition fit together.
